title: Oil surges as US strikes Iran — Brent hits $76.48/bbl, Strait of Hormuz closure risk escalates
summary: Brent crude rose 3%+ to $76.48/barrel following US strikes on Iran and revocation of a temporary Iranian oil sanctions waiver. The Strait of Hormuz is already closed; Iran has threatened to ask Houthis to close the Red Sea route if US strikes power infrastructure.
why: 中东局势骤升是本轮最大宏观风险：油价飙升推高通胀预期，拖累全球风险资产；港股A股能源板块受益但大盘承压；隐含波动率上行，sell put保证金需求增大。

title: 加息悬念拉满！美联储步入7月决议前噤声期，7月29日公布利率决议
summary: 美联储7月28-29日FOMC会议前正式进入噤声期。CME利率期货显示维持3.50-3.75%概率61.5%，加息25bp概率升至34.2%。18份点阵图中9份指向年末利率高于当前区间，降息叙事已被打破。
why: 美联储利率走向直接影响全球流动性与估值；若7月29日意外加息，成长股（腾讯、谷歌）及高PE标的将承压，sell put时需将加息风险纳入保证金计算。

title: AMD launches Helios AI rack system; Microsoft is first big customer — first genuine Nvidia rival in datacenter
summary: AMD unveiled Helios on July 20 integrating MI455X GPUs, EPYC Venice CPUs and 31TB HBM4 per rack, priced $5-5.5M. Microsoft Azure will deploy Helios for frontier model inference in H2 2026. First real competitor to Nvidia Blackwell/Vera Rubin; AMD stock +5%.
why: AI芯片市场竞争格局首次出现实质性系统级挑战；对英伟达长期护城河构成边际压力，同时利好AMD及HBM供应商SK海力士；持英伟达covered call仓位需注意股价上行受限风险。

title: 科创板迎来开市七周年：611家硬科技企业，三轮系统性改革持续推进
summary: 2026年7月22日，科创板正式开市七年。首批25家上市公司已扩展至611家硬科技军团。历经三轮系统性改革，集成电路、人工智能、生物医药三大板块日益壮大，资本市场服务新质生产力格局成型。
why: 政策积极背书科创板硬科技赛道；半导体与AI算力企业估值修复具有政策支撑，对A股科技ETF整体情绪利好，可关注相关板块sell put机会。

title: SK Hynix raises $26.5B in largest-ever US listing by a foreign company (SKHY); stock +13% on Nasdaq debut
summary: SK Hynix sold 177.9M ADSs at $149 each on July 10, raising $26.5B — topping Alibaba's 2014 record. Regular trading as SKHY began July 13. Stock debuted +13%; Korean shares then plunged 15.4% on arbitrage, dragging Korea's Kospi down 9%. Chairman highlighted enormous HBM demand.
why: SK海力士直接上市美股，HBM供应寡头垄断地位更加凸显；CSOP两倍做多产品持有者需留意美股/港股/韩股三地价差与再平衡风险；HBM4量产Q3开始是下一催化剂。

title: Tesla and Alphabet both report Q2 earnings tonight (Jul 22 US ET) — mega-cap double-header
summary: Tesla Q2: 480,126 deliveries (+25% YoY, first YoY growth in two years); consensus revenue ~$27.6B, GAAP EPS $0.36, gross margin ~19.5%. Alphabet Q2: consensus EPS $2.89, revenue $116.84B, Google Cloud focus after Q1 +63% YoY. Both report after US market close July 22.
why: 特斯拉+谷歌同日财报是全周最大事件风险；毛利率与云收入增速将分别定价两只核心持仓的期权波动率；结果公布后可能触发期权行权，建议在开盘前评估delta敞口。

title: Apple Intelligence cleared in China with Alibaba Qwen as sole AI language partner — BABA ADRs +4.78%
summary: China's CAC approved Apple Intelligence on July 15, with Alibaba Qwen handling language tasks and Baidu handling visual search. Apple is the only foreign AI provider on the CAC list. Apple shares +4.01% to record $327.50; BABA ADRs +4.78%. Consumer rollout expected within weeks to months.
why: 阿里云AI商业化重大里程碑：Qwen成为Apple Intelligence在华唯一语言模型，直接提升阿里云收入潜力与估值天花板；9988.HK仓位可适度上移covered call行权价锁利，或sell更远虚值put。

title: Circle (CRCL) +8% on OCC national trust bank approval — first stablecoin issuer with federal banking charter
summary: Circle received final OCC approval (July 10) for Circle National Trust, the first federal banking charter for a stablecoin issuer. Stock jumped 8% on July 21 as bulls targeted $70. USDC circulation $73.2B (+19%). Visa's Open USD platform is key competitive risk; Mizuho downgraded to Underperform July 14.
why: Circle获联邦银行牌照建立监管护城河，直接强化USDC合规叙事；GENIUS Act立法环境利好；竞争风险Visa Open USD限制上行，CRCL仍在期权波动率高位，sell put需设置足够安全垫。

title: Intel (INTC) regains $100 — Fortinet joins as first cybersecurity foundry customer; Q2 earnings Thursday Jul 23
summary: Intel stock reclaimed $100 on July 21 after Fortinet selected its 18A foundry process — the first cybersecurity sector customer. Q2 earnings due July 23: consensus $14.4B revenue, $0.22 non-GAAP EPS. Foundry division still posting $2.4B+ operating losses per quarter; HSBC raised target to $200.
why: 英特尔代工18A首次拿下网络安全客户，验证其向外部扩张能力；明日7/23财报是短期方向催化剂；期权隐含波动率高企，卖put须注意代工亏损是否超预期。

title: Nvidia (NVDA) Q2 guidance ~$91B; H200 China shipments begin; AMD Helios introduces new competition
summary: NVDA trades near $207 with Q2 revenue guidance ~$91B vs Q1 record $81.6B. H200 limited shipments to China now active. Goldman Sachs notes forward P/E at 21.7x vs 5-year avg 72x. AMD Helios introduces first rack-level AI system competition.
why: 英伟达Q2指引$91B需求强劲，中国H200出货是收入增量；AMD Helios令竞争预期转变但短期影响有限；高盛指出21.7倍前瞻PE历史偏低，sell put护城河逻辑仍完整，留意AMD竞争进展。
source: FX Leaders / Goldman Sachs via Longbridge

title: US confirms Nvidia H200 shipments to China begun — Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance cleared for 400K+ chips
summary: US Commerce Dept official confirmed H200 chips began shipping to ~10 Chinese firms including Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and ZTE. Volume described as trivial. Total approved demand exceeds 400K units; Chinese buyers interested in 2M+ total. 25% tariff applies; case-by-case licensing in place.
why: 腾讯和阿里获批采购H200是AI算力投资的实质性里程碑，强化两家公司AI业务竞争力；Nvidia中国收入有增量但受政策不确定性制约；持有腾讯/阿里者可观察H200到位后对业绩的拉动效应。

title: Palantir (PLTR) surges $107 to $133 on Nvidia sovereign AI deal, US Army NGC2 contract, and UK 750M GBP win
summary: Palantir partnered with Nvidia on a sovereign AI initiative for secure US government workloads. US Army selected Palantir Foundry as cloud data layer for NGC2 modernization. UK government awarded 750M GBP contract. D.A. Davidson upgraded to Buy; Wedbush maintains $230 target.
why: Palantir国防AI订单叠加Nvidia合作强化护城河，但PLTR估值已充分定价，适合在回调后再考虑sell put而非追高；关注Q2财报预计8月初中商业客户增速。

title: Micron (MU) CEO: HBM sold out through 2027 — memory supply tightness to persist beyond 2027
summary: Micron confirmed HBM production sold out for 2026 and 2027, with supply tightness expected to last beyond 2027. Q3 FY2026 revenue reached $10.85B (+37% YoY); non-GAAP gross margin 41.3%. Stock tripled in 2026 but recently pulled back 25%+ on competition and valuation concerns.
why: HBM售罄至2027年确认AI内存供需结构性紧缺，美光是英伟达/AMD关键供应商；25%回调后提供更具吸引力的sell put机会，需关注SK海力士HBM4量产进度对未来定价的冲击。

title: Pop Mart Labubu NYC exhibition opens Jul 17-Aug 31; FIFA 2026 World Cup collection launched in parallel
summary: Pop Mart THE MONSTERS 10th Anniversary World Tour opened July 17 at 423 W. 14th St NYC — first US stop after Shanghai, Taipei, HK, Paris, Tokyo — running through August 31. Simultaneously launched FIFA 2026 World Cup branded Labubu collection (blind boxes, plush, keychains).
why: 出海破圈里程碑：纽约展览+FIFA联名是泡泡玛特最高曝光度北美布局，短期提升IP溢价与流水；但Labubu Hair Salon系列二级价格低于发售价（IP疲劳信号），需关注新品销量是否能延续。

title: SK Hynix (SKHY) post-IPO whipsaws — Korean shares plunged 15.4%; HBM4E 12-layer samples shipped
summary: After the $26.5B Nasdaq IPO debut (+13% on July 10), SKHY whipsawed as Korean shares plunged 15.4% on arbitrage selling, dragging Kospi down 9%. Separately, SK Hynix confirmed shipment of 12-layer HBM4E samples (48GB capacity, 2TB/s bandwidth) to key customers.
why: SK海力士三地价差剧烈是持仓风险点；HBM4E样品发货领先竞争对手，HBM4量产Q3验证在即；CSOP两倍做多产品波动率大幅放大，需设置止损。

title: Laopu Gold (6181.HK) down 65% from peak — gold fell from $5,600 to below $4,000; counter-cyclical price hike backfired
summary: Laopu Gold shares near HK$370, down ~65% from July 2025 peak of HK$1,065. Gold prices fell ~30% from ~$5,600/oz to below $4,000. The company's Feb 2026 avg 20-30% price hike while rivals cut prices created severe demand headwinds. Nomura cut target to HK$905.
why: 老铺黄金已从顶部大幅调整，若黄金止跌企稳存在逆向修复机会；但定价策略失当与金价继续下行风险并存，估值修复节奏难判断，卖put须设置充足缓冲。

title: Walmart Sam's Club faces China food safety crackdown — regulator orders senior task force and supply chain overhaul
summary: China's market regulator ordered Walmart's Sam's Club to form a senior management task force to address food safety risks, requiring extensive supply chain inspections (Reuters, June 15). WMT at ~$111.85; US tariffs currently 10%, potentially rising to 12.5% after July 24, adding supply chain cost pressure.
why: 山姆中国食安问题若持续升级，将拖累沃尔玛中国业务增速预期；同时关税可能上调至12.5%（7月24日节点）对供应链成本形成双重压制，需关注WMT下一财报的中国区数据。
